notes.title: Tutorial bug in 1.9.13
notes.content:
We just became aware of a bug in tutorial on version 1.9.13 that causes the game to crash once exiting Dema's Labyrinth.  We have temporarily set 1.9.12 as the default build and will have a permanent fix for 1.9.13 uploaded shortly.  If you installed 1.9.13 and experienced this bug, you should be able to play as normal afterward.  Our apologies for the inconvenience.

Happy Raiding!

- The Iron 27 Team

notes.title: New Features in 1.8.32!
notes.content:
Daily Quests!

 New Daily Quests provide an efficient route to success in Shadow Guard and, of course, more XP, Gold, and Nori!


Shatter Vases!

 Were you slightly disappointed when you clicked a vase in raid and nothing happened?  Well your slight disappointment is our severe emergency; Vases in Raids are now breakable! (and in rare cases mildly lucrative)
 With Easter right around the corner, a long-armed egg may be tied to this and the tutorial heroes. We don't know.


Bug Fixes / Improvements

 Thanks to a more efficient asset loading method, Scene loads are now 4X Faster!
 UI Load Times improved
 Other misc performance improvements.


Known Bugs

 Faction Labyrinth Editor is down but should be patched shortly.


Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Update 1.8.16 now Live!
notes.content:
New Features

 More emphasis on Strategy in Faction and Custom Raids.  Faction Raid and Custom Raid guards will never be more than 4 levels higher or 4 levels lower than the attacking player's heroes.
 More details in Raid history.  View hero health and mana changes throughout the raid.


Bug Fixes / Optimizations

 Elite Guards now display proper stats in guard UIs and raid.  Elite Guard level rings are also now visible in Raids.
 More details on 'All guards of this type' owned on Guard Altar UI
 Verbiage is more clear on Chest Item behavior in Multiplayer vs Campaign Raids.
 Standard walk speed in Village is faster.
 Add skill break text to hero skills to make icon more obvious.
 Adjust guard request text to not clip with donate button in chat.
 Aesthetic and functional UI polish throughout.
 Many other minor misc bug fixes.


Known Bugs
 Sometimes the door going from floor 1 to floor 2 in faction raids does not open and you walk straight through it.  (will be fixed next patch)

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Major Update 1.8.3 now Live!
notes.content:
New Features

 Faction Raids! Work with your team members to design an epic Faction Labyrinth and wage war on opposing Factions.

 Item Chests!  Raiders no longer have only one chest to find.  Players must now find a good hiding spot for their Item Chest as well as their loot  Chest, and single player campaigns have several Item Chests hidden throughout.

 Elite Guards! Max level guards can now be made super powerful with Legendary Essence.

 Skill Breaking! Now you can build the ultimate Mage, Paladin, Priest, or Rogue by customizing skills for each of your heroes.

 Labyrinth and Worker Den Icons have been redesigned to more closely fit the HoSG visual style.

 Builders are now visible if you or a faction member are upgrading a Labyrinth or Den.

 Level up! Experience potions can be found in item chests or purchased from the Village Apothecary.

 No longer go in blind. Raid opponents' highest guard level is now shown on the Find Raid UI.

 General UI and game polish throughout.


Bug Fixes / Optimizations

 Guard models in manage guards interface should now load properly when the interface is first loaded.
 Players with large inventory bags or many heroes with many gems should experience less lag with loading these 100+ object UIs.


Cautious Optimism
 We are thrilled to bring you all these major updates, but are also fully aware of the bugs that may accompany them.  We have done a fair amount of testing in-house, but we can never fully simulate what hundreds of real players will encounter.  Please be patient and use the Bug Reporter in the settings menu to let us know of any problems you may encounter.

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Faction Raids & More Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Team up with faction members to build and raid Faction Mega Labyrinths!

In an effort to offer more mid and late game-play variety, we're excited to begin work on this awesome game mode. We still have a week or two to go before Faction Labyrinths are visible in your territory, but you may notice their mention in your Faction Fund in the meantime.

We're also working on other late game features such as Elite Guards and an epic Third Saga with a new Hero and 2 new Legendary Guards!

Happy Raiding!

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: 1.6.0 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
August 15, 2016 3:50pm CDT

We had to shut down the server for a while today to fully implement 1.6.0.  Please note that some of the server-side changes we had to implement will cause pre-1.6.0 clients to fail to properly display our "Server is down" message and will instead offer you a New Player button.  Please disregard this button (your old account is fine) and hang on a bit longer as we wrap up the new release.

Some things to look forward to:
- no more auto-optimization of hero items
- hero items will be seamlessly synchronized between devices for players on multiple devices.
- some faction chat improvements.
- other minor bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: Baton Rouge Flooding
notes.content:
Iron 27 Inc is located in Baton Rouge, Louisiana which has experienced record flooding over the past few days.  A key game update scheduled for tomorrow (Monday August 15, 2016) which targets hero gear and the removal of the "auto-optimize" feature may be pushed back as our studio and some of our team member's homes have been affected.

We will continue to push feature updates and bug fixes as quickly as possible.

Thanks again for your participation and patience.

- the Iron 27 Team

Good to go now.  Happy Raiding!  

- the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: Steam Launch!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has downloaded Heroes of Shadow Guard!  

We really appreciate the participation and feedback from the Steam community.  We performed months of testing before launch, but nothing compares to adding hundreds of players to your server overnight to find new bugs.  We launched a hot fix earlier today, but we're still hard at work; please bear with us as we go to work smashing some others we spotted today.

Happy raiding! 

- the Iron 27 team
